test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A person who is forgetful and unable to concentrate or think clearly
solution: The correct answer is '**Scatterbrain**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Scatterbrain**'. • It means** 'a person who tends to be disorganized and lacking in concentration'.** (एक व्यक्ति जो अव्यवस्थित हो जाता है और उसमें एकाग्रता की कमी होती है) • *Example: She struck me as a bit of a **scatterbrain**. * **Correct Answer:__** *Scatterbrain.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Intelligent**: having or showing the ability to understand, learn and think; clever. (समझने, सीखने और सोचने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न, बुद्धिमान; चतुर) • **Systematic**: done using a fixed plan or method. (निश्चित योजना या विधि से किया गया; सुव्‍यवस्थित, योजनानुसार) • **Logical**: seeming natural, reasonable or sensible (जो स्‍वाभाविक, युक्तिसंगत या तर्कयुक्त प्रतीत हो) 34:T59e, The correct answer is **'To want something more'.**
